crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Four to five distinct horizontal white bands on a high-contrast dark background located on the side of the neck.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Sharp linear boundary where the black-and-white neck pattern ends and the uniform brown-gray mantle begins.

other_distinctive_markers: Bold, multi-banded black and white neck collar pattern.
